plugins.name: Pure Control
plugins.blurb: LLM assistant that drives Ableton Live by chat.

detail.tagline: An AI assistant that lives inside Ableton Live — tell it what you want, and it drives your session.
detail.description: Pure Control puts a producer-grade AI assistant directly in your Ableton Live session. Type what you want — "build me a techno session at 128", "sidechain the bass to the kick", "warm up the master" — and it performs the moves on real devices through a native Live bridge: loading instruments, shaping sounds, building full arrangements. It runs on your Pure BPM Coinz balance, so there are no API keys to manage.
highlights: One-prompt session builder — drums, bass, lead hooks and arrangement, varied every time
Mix & mastering moves applied to your actual set — curated device chains, gain staging, sidechain
Chat mode for production questions, Work mode for hands-on control
requirements: Installs the Live remote script for you

plugins.name: Pure AI
plugins.blurb: Make full tracks and samples right inside your DAW.

detail.tagline: Generate tracks and samples, or buy from the Sample Bank, then drag them straight onto your timeline.
detail.description: Pure AI makes tracks and samples inside your DAW. For tracks, describe the song, pick an engine (MusicGPT, Mureka or MiniMax), write your own lyrics, let AI write them, or go instrumental, then set a voice and tempo and generate. For samples, describe a sound, pick Loop or One shot, and set the length and tempo. Or search the Pure BPM Sample Bank, preview the matches and get the ones you want. Everything you make or get is saved in your Library on your machine, ready to drag onto a track. Generation and Sample Bank purchases run on your COINZ balance.
highlights: Tracks from three engines: MusicGPT, Mureka and MiniMax, with the price shown before you generate
Samples from a text prompt: drum hits, FX, textures, loops and risers
Search the Pure BPM Sample Bank, preview, and confirm before any paid download
Everything saved in one Library on your machine, even if you close the plugin mid-run, ready to drag onto a track
requirements: A DAW that loads VST3 or Audio Unit plugins
AU & VST3 formats included (AU on Mac)

plugins.name: Pure Samples
plugins.blurb: Now part of Pure AI. Generate samples from text, or search the Pure BPM Sample Bank.

detail.tagline: Pure Samples is now part of Pure AI. Download Pure AI to make samples and search the Sample Bank.
detail.description: Everything Pure Samples did is now in Pure AI, on its Samples and Bank tabs, so this download installs Pure AI. If you already have Pure Samples it stays as it is, and projects that use it still open. Generation and Sample Bank purchases run on your COINZ balance.
highlights: Hi-fi 44.1 kHz stereo output: drum hits, FX, textures, loops and risers
Search the Pure BPM Sample Bank, preview, and confirm before any paid download
Loop or One shot, length and tempo controls, with smooth previews you can scrub
Every sample saved in your Library, even if you close the plugin mid-run, ready to drag onto any track
requirements: A DAW that loads VST3 or Audio Unit plugins
AU & VST3 formats included (AU on Mac)
